calc.formula: Required peak sales per program S = (EV the price puts on the pipeline + PV of the cash burn until the first launch) ÷ Σ LOAᵢ × fᵢ;  fᵢ = Σₖ shareₖ × margin × (1 − tax) ÷ (1 + r)^(Lᵢ + k − ½)
steps: EV of the pipeline = market value $3.64B − net cash $930.7M = $2.70B
cash burn $463.9M a year until the first launch in 1.6 years, discounted at 9.1% = $675.7M
programs: xen1101 (phase 3): LOA 52.4%, launch in 1.6 years, f = 0.792
Σ LOA × f = 0.415 → S = ($2.70B + $675.7M) ÷ 0.415 = $8.15B a year per program
the lead program alone (xen1101): $8.15B a year at peak
chance that no program is approved = Π (1 − LOAᵢ) = 47.6% (programs treated as independent)
